annotations.title: Where to live in a Portuguese city, area by area

description: Gives a flatin.pt city guide's verdict on where to live, area by area, with the reason, who each area suits and the sources. Use it to choose a neighbourhood; for one municipality's figures use `municipality_stats`, and for new homes there `search_newbuilds`. Without `city` it lists the cities and regions that have a guide. `profile` narrows the areas but never hides the ones we advise against. Noise and safety come as dated, sourced facts: a place's reputation, never a claim about its people. Show the guide's link to the user.

city.description: City or region with a guide, in any site language (Porto, Lisbon, Lisboa, Greater Porto, Algarve, Coimbra) or a municipality inside a guide (Gaia, Cascais, Faro). Omit to list the guides

include.description: Parts of the guide to return; all returns every section

language.description: Language of the answer: the guide or the definition, the text summary and the page links. Field names stay English. uk is accepted as ua.

profile.description: Keep the areas that suit this profile; profile never removes the areas we advise against

verdict.description: Keep only areas with this verdict: live (good to live), depends (depends on you), avoid (we advise against)

name: where_to_live

anyOf.description: Without city: the guides that exist.
With city: one guide's verdict area by area.

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.

title: Where to live in a Portuguese city, area by area
